# Thunderbird axe mutation-observer coverage planning

Existing infrastructure is `mail/test/browser/shared-modules/AxeHelpers.sys.mjs`, documented in `docs/testing/axe.md`; in-app-notification tests provide the local open-shadow-DOM pattern. `startAxeMutationObserver` is for content browsers and `startAxeMutationObserverInWindow` for chrome windows. Start in `add_setup`, observe a stable container, and finish before close/navigation. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
